_doc: HITRUST CSF overlay. Composed ON TOP of a FedRAMP baseline (and normally the HIPAA overlay too, since HITRUST CSF harmonizes HIPAA with other authorities). It does not change partition/region. It adds the HITRUST CSF control catalog and keeps the PHI-tightened guardrail/service posture from the HIPAA overlay. HITRUST is a certification framework: the CSF control mappings and the certification evidence are the toolkit's starting mapping and require assessor/ISSO review.
